title: Noor and the Regiment
author: Lior Eriksen
blurb: Wendell Yarrow, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
